review.claimGeneric: Left: the proposed content · Right: the evidence it cites.
review.doubtfulHint: Heuristic: the model's own rationale says “does not / not specifically / lacks”, yet the strength still closes the gap. Keyword match, not a verdict.
review.drift: Stated more strongly than the source
review.driftHint: The statement says must/shall, but none of the cited clauses contain a modal verb. Citation checks cannot catch this — the quote is verbatim, the conclusion is not. Tables are a known false positive: they carry obligations without modal verbs.
review.duplicateHint: An existing control has a word-for-word identical statement. Merging attaches this proposal's clauses to that control and keeps its title and statement; creating a separate control leaves two controls saying the same thing, with nothing to tell them apart later.
review.subtitle: Automated extraction verification and human review
review.failedBatchesHint: The model output for these batches was rejected, so the controls they should have produced are missing. Retrying only re-runs the failed batches; completed ones are untouched.
